===Levels 15–40: Edgeville Dungeon monkeybars===
Repeatedly crossing the [[Monkeybars (Edgeville Dungeon)|monkeybar shortcut]] in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]] offers up to 13,200 experience per hour. With the right camera angle, it is possible to keep the mouse cursor in one spot and continuously click. Because the monkeybars are located in the Wilderness, the player may get attacked by [[Player killing|player killers]].
